title.zh: Crypto Market Has 'Definitely Not Priced In' Clarity Act Surprise, Says Bernstein
title.en: Crypto Market Has 'Definitely Not Priced In' Clarity Act Surprise, Says Bernstein

current_state.zh: Bernstein analysts say crypto markets have not priced in a positive surprise on the Clarity Act, as Republicans offer concessions on ethics and banking ahead of a Senate procedural vote.
